source_evidence: EMMA is a free resource by the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board (MSRB) that makes available copies of official statements and advance refunding documents submitted to the MSRB by broker-dealers and banks that underwrite new issues of municipal securities.
answer: When researching municipal bonds, EMMA (Electronic Municipal Market Access) is a free resource from the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board. It provides copies of official statements and advance refunding documents submitted by underwriters of new municipal securities issues. EMMA also makes available continuing disclosure documents submitted by municipal issuers and other obligors. These documents are resources to review as you research a municipal bond.
